01 · Opening Brief
Why we play

Run the loop, master the kit, win as a guild

GOAL 01Run the full AI loop

Insight → judgement → plan → showcase, end to end, on a real business quest.

GOAL 02Master the toolkit

Hands-on with the pre-configured Skills / Agents arsenal — no setup friction.

GOAL 03Forge cross-BU alliances

8 guilds mixed across BUs and regions, one scoreboard.

GOAL 04Unlock the opportunity mindset

Learn to spot and pitch opportunities with AI, wherever they appear.

You leave today with a real proposal — and a way of working with AI you can carry into tomorrow.
01 · Opening Brief
What we play · The quests

Two official quests — pick your battleground

QUEST A · 4 GUILDS

GOLDEN TICKET — Fill the Stands at Doha 2030

OCA — Doha 2030 Ticketing & Fan Engagement Unit
MissionMake Asia's away crowd Doha's biggest in Asian Games history.
War chestUSD 30M total · MVP 5% = USD 1.5M · 3-month pilot in 2 Asian markets.
UnlockHit the pilot metrics → vendor list → full 18-month rollout.
QUEST B · 4 GUILDS

PANDA GOES GLOBAL — From Zoo Visit to World Membership

Chengdu Panda Base — Global Brand & IP Division
MissionTurn the world's most famous zoo into a global membership brand.
War chestUSD 11M total · MVP 10% = USD 1.1M · 3-month pilot in 2 overseas markets.
UnlockHit the pilot metrics → vendor list → full 18-month rollout.
01 · Opening Brief
How to play · The rules

Pick, duel, vote, win

Pick
Draw for order
8 guilds draw pick order. Each quest caps at 4 guilds, first come first served; once A fills, the rest take B.
Duel
Same-quest pairs
Guilds on the same quest meet head-to-head in D1–D4. Each duel runs 20 minutes.
Lucky Element
Assigned by the Host
The Host gives each team one element 1′ before the pitch and announces it to the audience; the team weaves it in.
Vote & win
Everyone votes live
The other 6 guilds and the host vote each duel. Total votes crown the Champion and Runner-up; every other guild takes a Playful Honor.
Same boss, pure skill — same-quest guilds only.

01 · Opening Brief
How to play · The rhythm

You make the calls

Three steps, every stage
  • 1 · The AI drafts a grounded menu — options backed by real data.
  • 2 · Your team chooses — pick from the menu, or add your own.
  • 3 · The AI executes and records — builds the output, captures the decision.
ResearchCreativeMetricsVisualPitch
Three red lines
  • Real data — numbers come from research, never invented.
  • Ascentium brand — every visual follows the brand guidelines.
  • Humans decide — the AI proposes; the team chooses.
  • Claim a role — each of the 14 takes a lane, so everyone contributes.
A finished first pass beats a perfect half — keep the loop moving.

Lucky Element
Assigned by the Host
The Host gives each team one element 1′ before the pitch and announces both to the audience; the team weaves it in and the Host scores how well it lands.
The pitch
5 minutes per team
The Showcase form: the insight, the idea and plan, and the results you expect — presented in five minutes.
Cross-Q, rally & vote
2′ + 1′ + 2′
Teams cross-question for 2′, rally for 1′ each, then the other 6 guilds vote while the Host adds 0–10 for the Lucky Element.
Every duel fits a 20-minute slot — same-quest guilds only, head to head.
05 · Showcase Rules · Voting
The Arena · Voting

How to Vote

Who votes
The other 6 guildsEvery guild except the two on stage — you sit out your own duel.
Your stickers
6 per personEach person holds six stickers, spent while their guild is off stage.
How to spend
Up to 2 per duelOne to each team, or both on the same team.
Host bonus
0–10 votesThe Host adds 0–10 for how well you used your Lucky Element.
Voting whiteboard
Each voter sticks a sticker into the team's space.
Team A1
Team A2
6 guilds × 14 people = up to 84 votes per duel
Total votes across all duels crown the Champion and Runner-up — tallied live on the big screen.
